{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] shredded cooked [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]]
* 2 ½ cups crumbled [[Cookbook:Feta Cheese|feta cheese]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Greek Yogurt Sauce|Greek Yogurt Sauce]]
* ½ cup fresh [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 4 flour [[Cookbook:Tortilla|tortillas]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine feta, chicken, yogurt sauce, and oregano. Set aside.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] one side of each tortilla with olive oil. Add ¼ of chicken mixture and roll the longer side up. 
#Repeat until all tortillas have been rolled.
#Sprinkle with additional chopped oregano, and serve cold as a snack.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* You could also do this with [[Cookbook:Pita|pitas]] for a more traditional version.
